name: Haha ga Dark Elf ni Natte Isekai kara Modottekita. ~Eroero Dekichau Oyako Kankei~
original_name: 母がダークエルフになって異世界から戻ってきた。 ～エロエロできちゃう親子関係～
source:
One night, Takumi Kusamori—a young man with little going for him—is chilling at home when a sudden flash of light blinds him.
When the light fades, he finds a dark elf standing before him.
………………Wait, a dark elf?!

“Don’t you recognize me? It’s me, your mom!”
“Huh? Whaaaaat?!”

His mother, who died in a car accident years ago, had been reincarnated as a dark elf in another world… and now she’s back.

At first, Takumi is completely thrown off. But eventually, he comes to accept this bizarre reality.
The days they share become a chance to relive the childhood he lost—a time full of warmth, care, and boundless love.
And before long, things start to get… intimate.

“We’ve been apart for so long… You can ask on me for anything you want, okay?..”

[Translated from [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_111.html#story]the official website[/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，草森拓海——一个毫无前途的年轻人——正在家里寒冷，突然一道闪光使他失明。
当光芒褪去时，他发现一个黑暗精灵站在他的面前。
………………等等，黑暗精灵？！

“你不认识我了吗？是我，你妈妈！”
“啊？什么啊？！”

多年前因车祸去世的母亲，转世为异世界的黑暗精灵……如今又回来了。

起初，拓海完全被抛弃了。但最终，他还是接受了这个奇怪的现实。
他们共同度过的日子让他有机会重温失去的童年——一段充满温暖、关怀和无限爱的时光。
不久之后，事情开始变得……亲密。

“我们分开这么久了……你有什么想要的都可以来找我，好吗？……”

[翻译自[url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_111.html#story]官网[/url]]
